issue: DRW_Viewport::parseCode previously treated group 46 as circleZoom. Autodesk documents the VIEWPORT circle-zoom field at group 72 and does not list group 46 in the VIEWPORT schema.

authorities.title: Autodesk VIEWPORT DXF reference
authorities.observation: The documented circle-zoom field is group 72; group 46 is absent from the VIEWPORT entity table.

authorities.title: Autodesk 2007 DXF reference archive
authorities.observation: The archived VIEWPORT table also places circle zoom at group 72.

implementation.change: Group 46 now follows the base entity's tolerant unknown-code path and cannot overwrite DRW_Viewport::circleZoom. Group 72 remains the documented circle-zoom parser field.
implementation.control: A runtime-generated minimal ASCII DXF VIEWPORT sets group 72 to 725 followed by undocumented group 46 set to 2500. Typed import retains circleZoom == 725.
implementation.fixturePolicy: The input is generated under the system temporary directory and removed by RAII. No drawing fixture is added.

claimBoundary: This is one generated ASCII parser field-isolation guard, not full VIEWPORT support.
Unknown group 46 is ignored; it is not retained for round-trip replay.
No Binary DXF, physical producer, native rendering, application, platform, or VIEWPORT handle-reference behavior is qualified.
This evidence does not promote any DWG/DXF support claim.
